descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在西安吃过腊汁肉夹馍后写完的小菜单。那句“今天这份”，最后接上了“已经吃完”。
descriptions.en: My Xi’an roujiamo menu, completed after lunch. “Today’s serving…” eventually became “…has been finished.”

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在西安尝碎馍与羊肉汤后留下的菜单，开头写得慢，午饭倒记得很清楚。
descriptions.en: A card from my Xi’an bowl of flatbread in lamb soup. The opening took a while; the meal was easier to remember.

names.en: A Second Look at the Terracotta Army

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在西安看兵马俑时留下的个人见闻便签。上面写着“看过，又看过”，提醒自己曾多停了一会儿。
descriptions.en: My own Xi’an visiting note says “looked, then looked again,” a reminder of spending a little longer with the Terracotta Army.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在西安吃羊肉泡馍时，我给身边的便纸起了这个名字。小勺歇一歇，我也慢慢尝一口。
descriptions.en: Named beside my yangrou paomo in Xi’an, when the spoon rested and I gave a mouthful a little time.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我沿西安城墙散步时写的小箭头，旁边补着“转身以后再看”。它是我的方向提醒。
descriptions.en: An arrow from my walk along Xi’an’s wall, with my own reminder to check again after turning around.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在西安，我和一位旅人各写一个起点，试着把我的两顿饭换个顺序讲。
descriptions.en: A traveler and I wrote two possible beginnings for telling my Xi’an meals in a different order.
